events.title: Seed LNCX and LUCX

events.title: LNCX and LUCX transduction
events.notes: Renamed from "medium change" (2026-08-10) — this is "next day" after the 2026-09-02 seeding, matching Umut's plan to transduce the day after seeding, with viruses frozen before vacation. Day 1 of the 6-day transduction+hygromycin-selection window (2026-09-03 to 2026-09-08), which ends on a Tuesday (not Fri/Sat/Sun) per Umut's constraint.

events.title: LNCX and LUCX Hygromycin
events.notes: Day 2 of the 6-day transduction+selection window (2026-09-03 transduction through 2026-09-08). Selection window end (2026-09-08) is a Tuesday, satisfying "shouldn't end on a Friday or weekend."

events.title: Pellet for RNA and Protein (SRB cells)

events.title: RNA isolation (ATF3 rep 3, cells seeded 08-10)

events.title: LunaScript cDNA conversion (ATF3 rep 3)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Carried over from Tue 08-11 per Umut. Runs straight off the RNA isolation, during the membrane blocking step.

events.notes: From -80C. No experiment same day (thaw-cell rule). Mandatory medium change next day (2026-09-01). Duration defaulted to 1h.

events.title: qPCR prep
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Moved again to sit after the cDNA conversion it depends on, during the streptavidin-HRP incubation. Plate is fridged overnight for Thursday's 12:00-14:00 qPCR.

events.title: CuAdapt cells — passage (one-off, missed Monday)
events.notes: One-off catch-up for the passage skipped on Monday 08-10. Placed after the copper treatment (ends 13:30) with the required 10-min gap. Does not affect the recurring Mon/Thu passage schedule. 2026-08-11: marked done by Umut from the app — not carried into 08-12.

events.title: Boil protein samples (for Western)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: First task of the day per Umut. Calculate concentrations, then boil. Feeds the Western gel loaded at 10:30.

events.title: Western — SDS-PAGE run
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Split into stages per Umut (biotin target, streptavidin-HRP conjugate, so no secondary step). 1.5 h is an estimate — adjust to your gel percentage and voltage. Unattended: virus medium change and CuAdapt work happen in this window.

events.title: Send plasmids to sequencing
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Carried over from Tue 08-11 per Umut. Second task of the day, between the protein boil and Western loading.

events.title: Western — load gel
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Load the boiled samples and start the run.

events.title: Western — assemble wet transfer
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Build the sandwich, add cold buffer and ice pack, start the transfer.

events.title: Western — wet transfer (2 h)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: 2 h as specified by Umut. Unattended — transfection and RNA isolation run in this window.

events.title: Western — block (BSA, biotin-free)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Block in BSA/TBS-T, NOT milk — milk carries endogenous biotin and will give high background with streptavidin-HRP. 1 h at room temperature.

events.title: Western — streptavidin-HRP incubation
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Conjugated, so no secondary antibody needed. 1 h at room temperature.

events.title: Western — ECL + image (biotin)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: First target: biotin.

events.title: Western — strip
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Strip buffer, then rinse well before re-blocking.

events.title: Western — re-block
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Second block after stripping, 1 h.

events.title: Western — 2nd target antibody
events.notes: 2026-08-11: ASSUMPTION: this antibody is also HRP-conjugated, 1 h at room temperature. If it needs a separate secondary, add ~1.5 h (wash + secondary); if it wants an overnight 4 C incubation, the imaging moves to Thursday morning.

events.title: Western — ECL + image (2nd target)
events.notes: 2026-08-11: Second target after stripping.
